description: Copies the user's workouts to local files so history does not depend on how far back Suunto's list reaches: <workoutKey>.fit (as Suunto sent it) and <workoutKey>.json (summary, FIT size, SHA-256) in ~/.suunto-mcp/archive/ (SUUNTO_ARCHIVE_DIR moves it; files 0600; needs a filesystem with hard links). Incremental: archived workouts are skipped; at most `limit` FIT files per call (1-20, default 20, newest first); `remaining` says how many are missing: CALL AGAIN until it is 0, unless a note says it will not help (failures are in `errors`). Each FIT is checked before its record is written (non-empty, FIT header, not shorter than the header says; CRC not checked). Only NEW files are written: nothing at Suunto changes and nothing is ever deleted or overwritten; a damaged, other-version, misfiled or size-mismatched record goes to `refused` and is left alone. Reads the newest 1000 workouts per call: older ones are not reachable. estimate_route_time reads the archive; other tools do not. Demo mode keeps the archive in memory. Annotated not read-only (writes local files), not idempotent (each call archives the next batch).

limit.description: Most FIT files to download this call (1-20, default 20).

name: archive_workouts
title: Archive workouts to local files (writes nothing at Suunto)
